message: I think the data system could be more intuitive. Right now, it takes too many clicks to enter patient info.

Agreed. We should also consider adding a feature to flag high-priority cases in the system. Btw, I really don't like the current way to display patients' gender. It's not friendly to people have special sexual orientation as I.
We need a quicker way to access patient history. Maybe a search bar at the top of the data system?
The data entry templates are too rigid. Customizable fields would help us adapt to different emergency scenarios.
Can we automate part of the data entry? Typing out everything in the ambulance is cumbersome.
Let's compile a list of common issues with the current data system and propose solutions.
